hypothesis: Distinct market mechanisms can coexist at genuinely different decision clocks and holding horizons; causal trailing four-calendar-week adverse-NET relative evidence may identify when to allocate exposure to one family rather than select a retrospective winning strategy. Each of the five primitives and one adaptive gate is predeclared jointly; conditional profitability is unproven.

sources.costMethod: research.multiscale_conditional_research.extract_costs then research.integrated_predictive_funded.cost_context; current-term authentic development BID/ASK+commission+conversion and modeled slippage, not actual fills

calendar.noCrossUTCDateForAnyHolding: Skip prospective source opportunities whose delayed entry and completed exit cross UTC calendar date; overnight funding and rollover not proven by historical fills.

families.mechanism: Within consecutive past 49 completed M5 prices, 9 prior return increments average absolute log movement <=0.75 of earlier 36, then the current completed M15 3-bar impulse exceeds 3x that suppressed movement AND 2bps; directional release follows for 30m.
families.benchmark: same-clock sign of prior completed H1 target log return, same target and cost
families.cloud: M5 Bars.ClosePrices; Math.Log; custom deterministic C#

families.mechanism: Prior 3.5h close-to-close log trend magnitude >=6bps; final 30m price adjustment opposes trend with 0.15..0.60 of magnitude; follow the prior 3.5h trend for 2h. Distinct from closed D1/H1 PVE2 exact rule.
families.benchmark: same-clock sign prior H1 target, same cost
families.cloud: H1 and M5 Bars + C# log returns

families.mechanism: Latest 3 complete M5 bars have average tick volume >=2.5x previous 21-bar average, 3-bar price move exceeds 1.8x past seven non-overlapping 3-bar absolute returns and 3bps; fade its direction over 15m.
families.benchmark: same-clock prior H1 target price momentum and cost
families.cloud: M5 Bars.TickVolumes and OHLC, pure C#

families.timeframe: first completed M5 bar after >=60m and <=72h broker timestamp gap
families.mechanism: Previous authentic M5 close precedes first reopened bar by 60m..72h and current bar open differs from prior close by >=8bps; forecast short-term retracement opposite the genuine observed open jump. Never synthesize absent bars.
families.benchmark: Predeclared cash-flat at true session reopen. Ordinary same-clock H1 prior momentum is unavailable across this genuine gap and must not be fabricated; zero-risk benchmark earns zero with zero trading fees. Source signal always pays its own modeled full spread/commission/slippage.
families.cloud: M5 Bars.OpenTimes and Open/Close; MarketHours may be read but no calendar service

families.category: multi-asset relative price / shared risk regime
families.timeframe: H1 completed clock with two contemporaneous 4h M5 paths
families.mechanism: At completed hourly clock both US500 and NAS100 have exact 49-bar 4h paths; if target 4h return minus peer 4h return exceeds 8bps in magnitude, fade the target's relative overperformance/underperformance for 90m. Two target perspectives disclosed; no uncosted synthetic hedge.
families.benchmark: same-clock own last H1 momentum, same target and cost
families.cloud: MarketData.GetBars(M5,symbol) two symbols, local pure C# beta-free normalized returns

adaptiveSystem.model: At each new original calendar week, calculate each family's trailing FOUR FULL prior weeks of all real matched source-proxy completed adverse-NET outcomes; if >=3 completed scored events and strictly positive trailing per-signal adverse NET, select the family with greatest trailing mean; ties in predeclared family id order. Freeze choice entire coming week, no contemporaneous outcome used. Do not select symbol or tune thresholds.
adaptiveSystem.selectionClock: fixed at calendar-week start, not signal timestamp after price outcome
adaptiveSystem.portfolioRule: take only source signals of chosen family; no more than one simultaneous proposal on exact target per clock, no modeled qualification by itself
adaptiveSystem.benchmark: same-clock target H1 momentum after same modeled adverse round-trip costs and cash-flat reference
adaptiveSystem.costMethod: same per-symbol observed development current-term central/adverse/stress cost; never zero for unknown
adaptiveSystem.risk: Even a supported model must pass single C# native EUR300 shared-capital ledger, actual minVolume/margin FX conversion/financing, account-wide floating equity and 30% drawdown; no broker trade claims

economicAdmission.priceOutcomeBasis: exact source M5 closes at t+5m and t+5+horizon with every intermediate M5 mark

statistical.pilot: use existing f2_preflight.prospective_economic_futility on DEVELOPMENT 26 weekly equal-asset means including genuine zero-opportunity weeks, across all 12 predeclared one-sided comparisons. F2 positive upper bound means plausible only; selection remains closed for failed group.
statistical.selection: for each F2-permitted group, 13 calendar-week equal-asset, equal-week proxy means. Conservative Bonferroni HAC3 one-sided LOWER for adverse source-proxy NET against flat and incremental adverse NET against costed same-clock target H1 momentum must BOTH exceed 0.
statistical.adaptiveAsOf: past four complete source calendar weeks only; development adaptive screen before selection; all 5 source families eligible as distinct inputs but no return-based winner retraining

product.nativeResearchParity: exact all-sign equality on deterministic authentic pre-scoring bounded M5 feature samples between Python and src/Mxm.Core/MultiFamilyNativeFeatures.cs run via src/Mxm.Replay
product.nativeRuntime: MxmCloud observation only; no new trading calls
